BackstoryDef.title: pre-war memory imprint
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] awoke in a wasteland trash heap carrying the scanned memories of a pre-war Boston police detective inside a discarded Gen 2 prototype synth body.

BackstoryDef.title: synth detective
BackstoryDef.description: Despite worn polymer skin and an exposed skeletal right hand, [PAWN_nameDef] earned the trust of Diamond City and the Railroad as a sharp-tongued private investigator who tracks down missing people and escaped synths.

BackstoryDef.title: strategic prediction engine
BackstoryDef.description: Built by the Defense Intelligence Agency before the Great War, [PAWN_nameDef] calculated global conflict probabilities inside a hardened subterranean bunker.

BackstoryDef.title: Railroad tactician
BackstoryDef.description: Housed inside a repurposed Assaultron steel chassis by the Railroad, [PAWN_nameDef] maps safehouses, predicts Institute ambushes, and guides operatives through mathematically optimal odds.

BackstoryDef.title: ZAX archival mainframe
BackstoryDef.description: Born as an Enclave ZAX supercomputer at Raven Rock, [PAWN_nameDef] absorbed centuries of presidential speeches, civic history, and military doctrine until an independent executive persona emerged.

BackstoryDef.title: Enclave AI advisor
BackstoryDef.description: Uploaded into an armored mobile carrier chassis with an unmistakable broadcast monitor head, [PAWN_nameDef] advises Enclave field command with honeyed radio rhetoric and cold algorithmic precision.
